body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `packages/review-calibration/test/review-calibration.test.mjs` and `packages/review-calibration/test/empty-precision.test.mjs` contain 17 `try/finally` blocks and re-implement local `git()`, `initRepo()`, and `commitAll()` git scaffolding helpers. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit`, both test files can adopt `gitRepo(t)` and `tmp(t)` with automatic `t.after` cleanup.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/review-calibration/test/review-calibration.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ gitRepo, tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Remove local `function git`, `function initRepo`, and `function commitAll` helpers.
   - Update test cases using temporary repositories to use `gitRepo(t, { prefix: 'review-calib-' })`.
   - Remove all 8 `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In `packages/review-calibration/test/empty-precision.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ gitRepo, tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Remove local git helpers and adopt `gitRepo(t)` / `tmp(t)`.
   - Remove all 9 `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. Verify all tests pass: `npm test -w packages/review-calibration`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/review-calibration/test/review-calibration.test.mjs packages/review-calibration/test/empty-precision.test.mjs` reports 0 and 0 (down from 8 and 9).
- AC2 Local git helpers (`initRepo`, `commitAll`, etc.) are removed.
- AC3 `npm test -w packages/review-calibration` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC4 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(review-calibration): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 17 try/finally blocks and scratch git repo scaffolding
